notes.title: EA Update 1.7.0 - Public Lobby Browser
notes.notes:
Summary
Update 1.7.0 brings public lobbies to Enemy On Board. This feature will eliminate the need to go into our Windwalk Games / Enemy On Board Discord to find matches. Additionally, we've addressed an FPS drop issue that occurs in custom-matches of less than 8 total players. 

I've made this a Major Update since our community has been "quite vocal" about it. Shout out to Cris for implementing the public lobbies and Rosco for addressing the FPS issue. The Windwalk Games team thanks you for your patience. 

Public Lobby Browser
Update 1.7.0 brings public lobbies to Enemy On Board. Private lobbies ARE STILL AVAILABLE and will not show up in the lobby browser. 

Functionality

Kick - Party leaders can kick a turbulent/unruly player from the lobby. The player will be able to return.
Ban - Party leader can ban a turbulent/unruly player from the lobby. The player will not be able to return to that specific lobby. 
 Transfer Party Leadership - Party leaders can transfer the responsibility to another user
 Within Lobby Invites - Steam Friends List integration and link sharing using the "Copy Link" button as per usual. 
 Mute - Left-click the Volume Icon to mute a player
 Volume Slider - Rightclick the Volume Icon and use the slider to adjust volume

Uses

Naming - Please try to be descriptive with your lobby names - example "Cool Game - Classic 2 Aliens" or "Custom 4 aliens 2x Speed"
Naming - Act like adults and refrain from using slurs. Report players and party-leaders with inappropriate names using the in-game "Report" button.


Other

[ADDED] Discord Rich Presence


Reported Bugs

[FIXED] FPS drops significantly during custom matches with less than 8 players.

notes.title: EA Update 1.6.0
notes.notes:
The last update for 2020 is here! What a year it’s been ~ we hope everyone has managed to stay healthy and safe. It’s been a blessing to get to know all of our community members even better in 2020. It's been a flagship year for Enemy On Board. 6-months since we launched into Early Access and we've had close to 300,000 people download a copy of our first game. It's come a long way, and we’re now looking forward to the new year. As many of you are aware, our team has also grown from 5 to 7 people and we're planning on hiring an Art Director soon. We're blessed to be able to make games for you and can't wait to see what 2021 will bring. 

With Update 1.6.0, we're moving away from our matchmaker and replaced it with a custom lobby system.  As our concurrent player count and download figures are low, we've moved away from the matchmaker and to a lobby system. These lobbies are fully customizable (change the # of aliens, speed, and a whole host of other options). We can't wait to see the memes that spring out of this. If our player base grows and there is a need for a matchmaker again, we will be able to add it back quickly. 

Here is a summary of the items included in this update: 
Matchmaking has been removed, moving to solely Custom lobbies
Balance tweaks you've been asking for
TSU and Anime Soul partner skins added - Join their linked Discord's for release event details soon
Added Credits Screen to the main menu homepage
Kickstarter flair applied to those we have proper Steam IDs from 
Discord Rich Presence updated for recognizing Enemy On Board
Credit Boost - 30% increase

Given the required database changes, Enemy On Board will be down today (12/16) for a good portion of the day.

UPDATE 1.6.0 DETAILS
MATCHMAKING
- Matchmaking has been removed and replaced with a lobby system. 
- Parties now have a party leader who controls lobby options.
- Added customization options for private lobbys. The following options are available:
General   
      - Alien Count
      - Global Damage modifier
      - Generators grant double ammo
      - Enable voicechat during crisis
      - Disable transformation during downtime
      - Round durations
Crew/Alien/Cyborg
      - Health Multiplier
      - Cooldown Multipler
      - Movespeed Multipler
      - Vision Multipler
      - Damage Multiplier
Alien      
      - Which aliens are allowed
      - Transformation duration
      - EP required to transform

BALANCE
- Wrench Base damage reduced.
- Xenna's mercenary perk now has a 15 second internal cooldown.
- Force baton now removes ammo on use, instead of on hit.
- Increased slowdrip regeneration by 25% at all levels/
- Aliens now only get 70% EP from EP gathering abilities before the first crisis.
- Two of the 3 vaccines now spawn after the first crisis has ended.

BUGS
- Fixed a bug where players could climb out of bounds off of certain props.
- Match history now displays all 8 players from a game.

OTHER
- Added in-game flair for Kickstarter backers.
- Added a credits section accessible through the main menu.  All Kickstarter backer's names have been added to the credits section
- Added a main menu button to the Discord for LFG.
- Added Discord Rich Presence
- Added two Promo skins for the winners of the GAR and Anime souls discord contests.

notes.title: DEDUCTION DONE DEADLY - EA UPDATE 1.5.0

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34273441/2691a21184412f30cab2636dfccbdd3a6da22f88.jpg
We've been hard at work over here at Windwalk. As many of you know, since the last update, we've added 2 new engineers to the team, Kristian and Josh. They are now fully on board and working hard. We're so grateful to have them as we push EOB to the next level at full speed. 

Early Access v1.5.0 represents our largest update to date.  In this update, we've made large changes to up the focus on deductive gameplay elements and reduce the amount of combat in game. With 8 players, 6 Crew and 2 Aliens, being discovered early marks almost certain death. We also needed a bigger ship to house more players, so we decided to fully revamp the Andromeda. Map 2 is now in process. Finally, we've heard your comments - WASD is now the control scheme. We sincerely thank you for drilling this feedback home and can't wait for you to play EOB 1.5.0.

Storefront

notes.title: Patch v1.3.1
notes.notes:
With our latest big content update (v1.3.0) came a few bugs.

Here's what we have fixed:

FPS Drops and Map Falling
There was a bug in an "update" loop which meant it sent logs at the framerate specified per account (ie. 60 times a second if framerate was set at 60fps).

This slows down the computer and puts a ton of load on our remote logging service.

Cris has found a quick fix for this, and we'll be finding time to find the proper and perfect fix very soon!

Faulty Items
We fixed almost immediately after this was discovered because we're just the best devs, but this was a problem where dropped Shield Cells and Bulletproof Vests would recharge with full armor.

This was not intended, and has been fixed.


With this quick patch, Enemy On Board should be back to the game you know and love! See you onboard.

Epinephrine: Gain movement speed for duration after use of a character ability. This does not apply to alien abilities.

https://steam-static.s3-us-west-1.amazonaws.com/patch-1-3-0/whats-new.gif
Balance Changes
New Mechanic - Armor
Armor blocks damage before it is dealt to players. Items that provide armor are active even if they are not in the currently equipped slot.
Knife
 Knife base damage reduced 14 => 12.5
Scientist Teleport
 The teleporter now dies 5 seconds after a portal is opened, or when a second player travels through it. (This means that the beacon will explode as soon as a second player travels through it)
Mercenary

Ninja

Lightweight
 Debuff linger duration decreased from .2 -> .15 seconds
Bedside Manner
No longer applies to self-healing

EscapePod

Wrench

Abilities

Tutorials

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.1
notes.notes:
Now that we're finally in Early Access, we have a whole new set of challenges.

The most difficult of all so far have been struggling over naming the version of our Patch Notes ;) 

Did we want to do "v1.1" or "v1.0.1" or should we just call them "hotfixes"? 
Do we want to save version 1.0 for launch?
Maybe we should just give them all cool-sounding names?

So we decided that for now, we will use the format: 

v ..

Just a little insight into how we will do things ːsteamhappyː

Patch Notes v1.0.1
We've been listening to a ton of feedback from the community, and this week, we wanted to address some of the low-hanging-fruit problems and issues.
 Voice upgrades to hopefully fix some microphone issues

Note: Players with MacOS may still experience microphone issues. This issue is still one of our highest priority.

 Bug fixes for Tooltips and Game End Screen
 Upgrading our "Report Player" functionality, including ban visibility

When reporting players, there are now categories for grievances (ie. Hate Speech, Offensive Name, Teaming, etc). In addition, banned players will receive a pop-up when they log into the game explaining their banned condition.

 Starting Item Unlocks for progressing new players

Players will now be introduced to each new starting item over the course of a few games played.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34273441/c7b365f6cad92b00a47ab0998d74e091b4e72887.png

With each new starting item unlock, there will be a descriptive pop-up detailing how the item is used.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34273441/119075bb57011b7c33c95d7c317173b97ceadc4a.png


We are still working on a ton of other new features and fixes to address the needs of our community. Lots more to come very soon!

Hop into the Discord to check our #dev-diaries channel to see what exactly we're working on, and to chat with us about how we can make the game better!

- Shi

notes.title: Patch Notes - 3/12/2020
notes.notes:
General:

Pop-up when starting the game, and after a round that will inform players if a new version of EoB has been deployed
Added character abilities, character bios, and redid the character UI. Each character now has a unique ability. Characters have been renamed.
 Stun gun now locks doors on hit
 Armory and Escape pod doors now function as normal doors when unlocked, rather than being always open.



Character reworks:   

Brocollete -> Xenna - The Torrelian Captain 

Ability: Torrelian Shield. Xenna uses her ancient artifact to create a brief shield around her, which fully blocks a single instance of damage.
 


Engineer -> Triss - The Spy

Ability: Target Location. Triss activates her scanner, revealing the location of all players on the minimap and through fog of war.
 


Medic -> Otto - The Medic

Ability: Bio-Stabilizer. Otto places a healing beacon which gradually heals the nearby player with the lowest health.
 


Monkey -> Monkus - The Space Monkey

Ability: Monkey Roll. Monkus tucks and rolls in the direction of movement, evading all attacks and moving him forward a short distance..
 


Scientist -> Virgil - The Scientist 

Ability: Teleportation Field. Virgil places a teleport beacon on the ground which he can later teleport to instantly. His teleportation leaves behind a portal which an additional player may travel through.
 


Trapper -> Lucius - The Commando

Ability: Adrenaline Rush. Lucius gets way too excited, gaining movespeed, and reducing incoming damage and knockbacks for a short duration.
 


Cadet -> Jessie - The Cadet

Ability: Access Denied. Jessie is able to lock the nearest blast door for a short duration.
 


Sarrel -> Sarrel - The Grifter

Ability: Charming Gaze. With her silver tongue, Sarrel launches a charming lure, forcing her target towards her for a short duration.

JOIN US FOR GAME NIGHT WITH THE DEVS TONIGHT, 7/11/19, FROM 16:00-19:00PM PST

Here are the weekly patch notes. For more information please visit our Discord. 

Characters:
Character rigging has been majorly improved. Most animations as well as the pick screen character renditions should look much better.
Added the Scientist.
Added 2 recolors for all characters.
Locked all recolors besides medic recolors.

General:
Added player input buffering. Buffered commands are valid for 0.5s. (EX: Pressing swap then attack during an attack will cause the player to immediately swap items and use their other item following the completion of the first).

Item Changes:
Force Baton: Wall collision duration reduced.Small forward lunge on attack removed.

Laser Sword: Small forward lunge on attack removed.
Stim Serum: Reduced cast time 0.75s -> 0.4s. 
Alien Attack: The alien can move and turn at full speed while attacking.The attack hitbox is now active only for a single frame so it can no longer be smeared.

Miscellaneous: 
Added a new model for open alien eggs.
Improvements to player combat should make all item usage feel smoother.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 7/4/19
notes.notes:
JULY 4 PATCH NOTES

We are going to be putting the weekly patch notes here for our players, as well as in our Discord. 

Alien tutorial: The new alien tutorial introduces players to both types of alien as well as the vaccine

Game Start Reworked: Players now spawn 'randomly' around the map. Starting loot now can be found randomly around the ship. Increased number of starting items from six to eight. The old starting room now has a second door that exits into the long hallway between B and C generators. The repair kit room (room in the center of the map) now always starts with 1 syringe, 1 bandage, and 1 stim cola.

Omnipotent end game stats: 
Alien or Human
Starting Items
Character Skin
Damage Done
Healing Done
Player Kills
Generators Repaired

Item Changes
Health Kit: Duration is now 15s on the ground. Fixed a bug allowing 2 players to be healed at once.
Jump Drive: Jump range shortened. Max charges increased from 2 -> 4.Charges granted per generator 1 -> 2. Slow duration on humans increased 0.5s -> .75s. Slow duration aliens increased 0.5s -> 2.25s. Cast time slightly decreased 0.5s -> 0.3s. 
Snare Trap: Damage decreased 15 -> 12.5 per trap.
Force Baton: Removed the uncharged active. Slightly reduced the duration of the wall collision debuff as some players were being stunned at the very tail end of the effect when they should not have been.
Stim Serum: Reduced self-damage 15 -> 10. Increased damage tickrate.
Alien Vaccine:Increased damage tickrate, total damage is unchanged.

VFX & Misc.: Added effects for the inventory and loadout screens when changing item or character selection. Added a new visual for the alien transformation egg.

Alien Attack: The Alien attack has been reworked to be less laggy!
Aliens can no longer turn while attacking. Aliens can control the distance they lunge. Removing the movement button will cause the alien to stop lunging forward


Added a USA Monkey skin for 4th of July that can be unlocked by playing 20 games over the next week
To track this everyone in game level will show as being reset. Rest assured we still have everyone's full XP stored on our end. The skin will unlock when your profile reaches level 5.
